description: This file contains unit tests for the AuthorizationCodeRepository class in the OAuth module of the OrangeHRM system. It tests creation, persistence, revocation, and status checking of OAuth authorization codes.

classes.name: AuthorizationCodeRepositoryTest
classes.description: Unit test class for AuthorizationCodeRepository, testing its methods related to OAuth authorization codes.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test fixture by loading test data from a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testGetNewAuthCode
methods.description: Tests the creation of a new AuthCodeEntity instance and verifies initial property states.

methods.name: testPersistNewAuthCode
methods.description: Tests persisting a new authorization code, verifying database properties and linkage to entity.

methods.name: testPersistNewAuthCodeWithExistingAuthCode
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to persist a duplicate auth code throws an exception.

methods.name: testRevokeAuthCode
methods.description: Tests revoking an existing auth code and verifies its revoked status.

methods.name: testRevokeNonExistingAuthCode
methods.description: Tests revoke behavior when the auth code does not exist; expects silent handling.

methods.name: testIsAuthCodeRevoked
methods.description: Checks if a particular auth code is correctly reported as revoked or active.

methods.name: testIsAuthCodeRevokedForNonExistingAuthCode
methods.description: Verifies that querying revocation status for a non-existent auth code returns true.
